product_overview: Familiarise is a B2B2C consulting and mentorship marketplace that connects consultants with individual consultees and enterprise organizations. It supports onboarding, discovery, bookings, payments, meetings, payouts, and compliance across consumer and enterprise workflows.
core_goals: Enable secure email/password and OAuth authentication with cookie-based sessions
Support consultant and consultee onboarding with profile management
Provide discovery and booking flows for consultations, subscriptions, webinars, classes, and trials
Process flexible multi-leg payments, refunds, discounts, and webhook-driven payment lifecycle events
Deliver meeting, recording, document upload, and post-session feedback experiences
Support consultant earnings, payouts, referrals, support tickets, and notification preferences
Offer enterprise organization management, memberships, SSO/SCIM, programs, invoicing, payouts, and compliance controls

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can sign up, sign in, sign out, and manage password reset flows using BetterAuth cookie-based sessions.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/sign-up/email with valid email, password, and name -> Receive 200 with created user
POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with Set-Cookie session and user object -> Use session cookie on authenticated requests
POST /api/auth/request-password-reset with existing email and redirectTo URL -> Receive 200 confirmation message
POST /api/auth/reset-password with valid token and newPassword -> Receive 200 OK
POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials
POST /api/auth/sign-out with valid session and matching Origin header -> Receive 200 {success:true}
POST /api/auth/reset-password with expired or invalid token -> Receive 400 Invalid or expired token

features.name: Health Check
features.description: A public endpoint provides operational status, including database connectivity and maintenance state.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 with status healthy and database connected
GET /api/health during maintenance window -> Receive 200 with maintenance phase reflected in response
GET /api/health when service is degraded -> Receive non-healthy status details in response payload

POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> PUT /api/user/consultants/[consultantId] with valid bio, headline, languages, and experience -> Receive 200 updated ConsultantProfile
POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> PUT /api/user/consultants/[consultantId] with invalid field types -> Receive 400 Validation error
GET /api/profiles/consultant without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> GET /api/profiles/consultee -> Receive 200 ConsulteeProfile

features.name: Explore & Discovery
features.description: Authenticated users can search consultants and browse discovery surfaces for experts, activities, programs, and enterprise offerings.

POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> GET /api/consultants/search?q=nonexistent -> Receive 200 with empty data array

GET /api/plans/consultations -> Receive 200 consultation plan list -> POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/bookings/consultations/[consultationId]/validate with conflicting slots -> Receive 400 Slot conflict or invalid

POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/bookings/consultations/[consultationId]/allocate with already taken slot and paymentId -> Receive 409 Slot already taken

features.name: Booking - Subscription (1:1 recurring)

user_flows: GET /api/plans/subscriptions -> Receive 200 subscription plan list -> POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/bookings/subscriptions/[subscriptionId]/validate with recurring slots -> Receive 200 ValidationResult -> POST /api/checkout with eventType subscription, eventId, slots, and fundingSources -> Receive 200 paymentId and razorpayOrderId -> PATCH /api/bookings/subscriptions/[subscriptionId]/allocate with paymentId and slots -> Receive 200 Appointment[]

POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/bookings/subscriptions/[subscriptionId]/validate with invalid recurring slot selection -> Receive 200 ValidationResult indicating failure or blocked allocation

POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/bookings/subscriptions/[subscriptionId]/allocate before successful payment -> Receive error response due to missing or invalid payment context

POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/waitlist with webinarId for a full webinar -> Receive 200 waitlist entry
POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/waitlist with the same webinarId twice -> Receive 409 Already on waitlist

GET /api/plans/webinars -> Receive 200 webinar plan list -> POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/bookings/webinars/[webinarId]/validate with invalid seat selection -> Receive error response

POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> PATCH /api/bookings/classes/[classId]/allocate with an already occupied class slot -> Receive error response or conflict

GET /api/plans/classes -> Receive 200 class plan list -> POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> POST /api/bookings/classes/[classId]/validate with invalid recurring slot selection -> Receive validation error

POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid credentials -> Receive session cookie -> PATCH /api/appointments/[appointmentId]/reschedule with new slots -> Receive 200 updated Appointment

test_setup.auth_note: Authentication uses BetterAuth cookie sessions. Sign in once at the start of a test suite by calling POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with the test credentials below, then pass the returned Set-Cookie header value as Cookie on all subsequent requests. DO NOT sign in independently in each test case — the authLimiter allows only 10 sign-in attempts per 15 minutes per IP (200/15min in dev), so re-signing in each test will trigger HTTP 429 cascades. CSRF: any state-changing endpoint (sign-out, reset-password) requires the header Origin: http://localhost:3000 or BetterAuth will reject with 403. Invalid credentials return 401 (not 400). Sign-out response body is JSON {success:true}.

rate_limits.auth: 10 sign-in/sign-up attempts per 15 minutes per IP
